title: AI Engineer
jobDescription: Work in a multidisciplinary Data & Analytics team to deliver AI‑driven solutions for multiple business brands and domains. Design, build, and deploy end‑to‑end AI solutions, with a strong focus on Generative AI, Agentic AI, and scalable AI pipelines. Develop AI applications using modern frameworks and technologies such as Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, LangChain, vector databases, and fine‑tuned LLMs. Translating business needs into concrete AI solutions in close collaboration with internal business partners and IT teams. Act as a bridge between technical AI capabilities and practical business requirements, ensuring measurable business value. Identify and propose new AI opportunities, including intelligent assistants, automated workflows, RAG solutions, and AI agents. Contribute to a wide range of AI use cases, including search, recommendation systems, document and language processing, and autonomous agents at scale. Stay up to date with emerging AI trends and technologies and actively share knowledge to strengthen the organization’s AI maturity Requirements AI Engineer with a master’s degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field, and 3–5 years of hands‑on experience in AI development. Should have 10 to 15 years of working experience in Data-related projects. Strong expertise in machine learning, large language models (LLMs), and Generative AI, with practical experience building AI‑driven applications. Proficient in Python for designing, implementing, and integrating AI solutions. Hands‑on experience with GenAI frameworks and tools such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, and similar ecosystems; solid understanding of Agentic AI patterns. Experienced in cloud‑based AI development and deployment, particularly on Microsoft Azure, including Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, and Azure ML. Capable of deploying, managing, and scaling production‑grade AI solutions in cloud environments. Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to translate complex AI concepts into clear business value. Effective communicator who can collaborate with both technical teams and non‑technical stakeholders. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field such as Statistics, AI / ML / NLP is an added value. Benefits What We Offer Stimulating work environment – You enter an incredibly fascinating and rich data and AI environment, where you receive room for initiative and play a key role in the AI transformation of one of Belgium’s largest retail groups. Continuous learning opportunities – Besides a wide range of internal training programs, you also have the opportunity to follow additional development paths focused on AI, cloud and innovation. This allows you to build your technical skills continuously, business knowledge and social competencies. At Colruyt Group, you can work differently. You, as a person, are at the center—and you’ll notice that right away. You can sharpen your skills thanks to our development‑oriented approach and grow internally if you wish. Whether you’re an analyst, store employee, marketeer or technician, you’ll surely find a job that suits you. Colruyt Group believes in the power of diversity, equality and inclusion. Everyone is welcome to apply, and we offer equal opportunities to all.
